summary: Lixte Biotechnology Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement related to its acquisition of NOMAD Transportable Power Systems, Inc. On June 17, 2026, Lixte issued a $6.5 million secured promissory note to NOMAD, secured by substantially all NOMAD assets, to repay NOMAD's existing debt and fund working capital. The note matures 30 days from issuance, with automatic 30-day extensions while the merger agreement remains in effect. Upon merger close, the note will be offset against amounts due to NOMAD. If the merger terminates due to Lixte's breach, the note is repayable within six months; if NOMAD's breach, within three days. The merger was previously disclosed on Form 8-K filed June 16, 2026. Watch for merger closing conditions, regulatory approvals, and NOMAD's asset valuation.
